headword: スーパーボールすくい
reading: すーぱーぼーるすくい

definitions.explanation: A festival stall game in which players scoop floating rubber bouncy balls from a tub of water using a thin paper scoop (ポイ), keeping whatever they catch before the paper tears. A common alternative to {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい (goldfish scooping).

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りでスーパーボールすくいをした。
examples.english: I played the superball scooping game at the festival.

examples.japanese: スーパーボールすくいで{五個|ごこ}も{取|と}れた。
examples.english: I managed to scoop up as many as five balls in the superball game.

examples.japanese: {金魚|きんぎょ}すくいよりスーパーボールすくいの{方|ほう}が、{小|ちい}さい{子|こ}でも{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: Compared with goldfish scooping, superball scooping is something even small children can enjoy.

notes:
A staple game at summer festival ({夏祭|なつまつ}り) and {縁日|えんにち} stalls. Players use a fragile paper scoop (ポイ) to lift floating rubber balls out of water before it breaks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパーボールすくいをする: to play superball scooping
- ポイですくう: to scoop with a paper scoop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい: goldfish scooping — the same game played with live goldfish; the classic version
